summary: Share the existing timeline append body between production and its private output transaction controls

replay.detail: Existing ownership checks, append order, event bytes, retention, commit and wake behavior unchanged; no output producer installed.

schema.detail: No spool schema/index migration or statement change; existing append SQL is extracted into one transaction-local helper.

rules.detail: No fleet/checkpoint rule, claim admission or turn obligation change.

compatibility.detail: Public API and event contracts unchanged; output types/callers remain cfg(test) only.

downtime.detail: No new connection, transaction, query, scheduling, cache, timer or service change.

recovery.detail: No physical authority or native protocol acceptance; original recovery hold remains separate.
